## SPE technical papers

The following papers were produced from HPHT carbonate completion work undertaken with **Petronas Carigali** in Malaysia. They are referenced by their SPE paper number; full text is available through OnePetro and the SPE digital library.

| SPE No. | Year | Topic |
|---|---|---|
| **SPE 186236** | 2017 | HPHT carbonate completions — design considerations |
| **SPE 186940** | 2017 | HPHT carbonate completions — material selection and operational outcomes |
| **SPE 186948** | 2017 | HPHT carbonate completions — sand-control alternatives in carbonate matrix |
| **SPE 191087** | 2018 | HPHT carbonate completions — programme retrospective |

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Verification**: each paper is searchable directly on [OnePetro](https://onepetro.org/) by its SPE number. If you would like the formal citation block (full author list, DOI, conference proceedings reference), please [contact me](mailto:miguel.rosato@me.com) and I will share the BibTeX entries.
:::

## In preparation

I am preparing two further pieces for publication:

1.  **Workover programme scaling at a mature giant field** — a structured retrospective on the operational and management changes that delivered the +39% workover throughput at constant rig count (2024 → 2025), drafted for SPE conference submission. Anonymised where required.

2.  **Mixed-integer linear programming for workover fleet optimisation under NPT uncertainty** — a methodology paper based on Section 11 of the Imperial College Capstone, drafted for SPE / SPE Reservoir Evaluation & Engineering submission.
